The '''Circle Maintenance Corridor''' was a roadway near the [[House Traders' Circle|House Trader's Circle]] in [[King's Pass]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. It was used primarily for maintenance and facilities for the nearby market, though [[House Rist]] took over the roadway and the facilities during the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Eckard Lokin]] retired to an estate at the southern end of the Corridor.

==Behind the scenes==
The Circle Maintenance Corridor first appeared as a Heroic area in King's Pass on Alderaan in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The buildings in the area were moved around to accommodate a new house belonging to Doctor Lokin in the [[2015]] Digital Expansion, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''.
